data.title: Florida Men: Chicago Fire vs Orlando City
data.content:
The Chicago Fire are set to host Orlando City in their final regular season game at Soldier Field this season. The Fire have a playoff spot secured but a lot on the line, while Orlando, currently in seventh and just four points clear of the playoff line, have everything to play for. [...] Still: Lewandowski knows how to find the back of the net. His last tally came the last time he faced a team from Florida that was largely put on the map by a global star from the world stage.

Now that he's facing another Florida team with a globally-known star, will he once again find that simple joy?

Match Info & How to Watch

📅 Date & Time Wednesday, October 28 · 7:30 PM CT

📍 Location Soldier Field · Chicago, Illinois

🌤️ Forecast Partly cloudy · 65°F

📺 TV Apple TV [...] For Orlando, it's simple: A playoff spot is likely – our model has them at a 69% being in by the final whistle on Decision Day – but as nice as those odds are, they still need to points to get in. The three they can get from a win over the Fire, combined with a Columbus loss to FC Dallas in Frisco would be enough to punch their ticket.
